import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

MAXN = 7
MOD = 10**9 + 7
E100 = 570000004

n = 0
g = []

def compute(idx, mask, n, g, nxt, S, bitcnt, dp):
    if mask == 0:
        return 0
    if idx == n:
        return 1
    if (idx, mask) in dp:
        return dp[(idx, mask)]
    total_prob = 0
    for subset_mask in range(1 << n):
        prob = 1
        for j in range(n):
            if subset_mask & (1 << j):
                prob = (g[idx][j] * prob) % MOD
            else:
                prob = ((1 - g[idx][j]) * prob) % MOD
        new_mask = 0
        for b in range(35):
            if (1 << b) & mask:
                new_mask |= nxt[subset_mask][S[idx][b]]
        total_prob = (total_prob + prob * compute(idx + 1, new_mask, n, g, nxt, S, bitcnt, dp)) % MOD
    dp[(idx, mask)] = total_prob
    return total_prob

def main():
    global n, g, nxt, S, bitcnt
    data = list(map(int, input().split()))
    n = data[0]
    g = [data[1 + i * n: 1 + (i + 1) * n] for i in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            g[i][j] = g[i][j] * E100 % MOD

    bitcnt = [0] * (1 << n)
    for i in range(1, 1 << n):
        bitcnt[i] = bitcnt[i ^ (i & -i)] + 1

    S = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    id_map = [0] * (1 << n)
    for i in range(1 << n):
        cnt = bitcnt[i]
        id_map[i] = len(S[cnt])
        S[cnt].append(i)

    nxt = [[0] * (1 << n) for _ in range(1 << n)]
    for i in range(1 << n):
        for j in range(1 << n):
            for k in range(n):
                if (i & (1 << k)) and not (j & (1 << k)):
                    nxt[i][j] |= 1 << id_map[j | (1 << k)]

    dp = {}
    answer = compute(0, 1, n, g, nxt, S, bitcnt, dp)
    answer = (answer % MOD + MOD) % MOD
    print(answer)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
